body.value: The five biggest-selling shops of the 57 Contoso still trades from, biggest first, and against each the money its customers were actually charged — after discount, in USD — summed over every order on record from 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31. One row per shop. All five are far above the average trading shop, which takes 2,259,981.85 over the same period, so the "more than the average store" condition cuts nobody from this list: the fifth shop is 1.59 times the average. Not in these figures: the web shop, which took 86,790,054.13 on its own and would head the list if it counted as a store; the 16 closed premises, 3,205,452.33 between them; the discount itself, 8,175,287.92 across these 57 shops, which is the gap between this net figure and the list-price one.
